review_notes.platform_install: The NoRedirect class is defined at top level and used by an opener with ProxyHandler({}); URL gate requires HTTPS, an approved oaiusercontent.com subdomain and default/443 port. ZIP and TAR are pinned and verified before extraction; platform file/link manifest is checked before a platform-only locked no-compile venv is created; pip check and pointer invariance are required. The script records and preserves incomplete outcomes; it does not switch release pointers or activate services.
review_notes.core_prepare: Copies only the 69 hash-verified current-core files, the exact tested HTTP extraction result, four runtime modules and the SHA-pinned ACL helper into a new immutable path. It verifies copied source hashes and records an integration manifest with active=false; no current pointer, active HTTP file, service, socket or DB is changed by this script.
review_notes.integrated_core_test: The script blocks Python TCP connect/connect_ex and DNS calls and runs the fixed 1,035-test suite. It must execute in the declared native PrivateNetwork sandbox because Python monkeypatches are not an OS-level barrier against subprocess or raw UDP traffic.
review_notes.native_unit: The reviewed unit uses dedicated UID/GID, bounded memory/tasks and kill-group shutdown, private read/write paths, old credential directories inaccessible, and a separate store-check socket. ExecStartPre helper path is now supplied by prepare-core and the helper source hash is pinned.

resource_budget.assessment: Narrow source-level pass. Installer rechecks free blocks, inodes and memory before work and reserve afterward; core preparation remains dependent on a fresh resource readback before copying. Abort on any reserve shortfall; no cleanup or deduplication.
